name: KRAFTON, Inc.
summary: KRAFTON, Inc. is a global entertainment company primarily engaged in the creation, development, and distribution of video games. The firm's offerings encompass games for personal computers, mobile platforms, and gaming consoles, serving both domestic South Korean and international markets. Established in 2007, the company, originally known as Bluehole Studio Inc., officially adopted the name KRAFTON, Inc. in November 2018. Its corporate headquarters are located in Seongnam, South Korea.
